content:
{
  "project": "Quai-RADAR",
  "what_building": "An intelligence dashboard for the Quai Network that monitors market data, protocol dynamics (SOAP), and external blockchain news. It uses LLMs to extract structured knowledge from news feeds and generate daily research briefs with implications for QUAI/QI assets.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_news_feed",
    "extract_kg_facts",
    "fetch_live_market_data",
    "generate_research_brief"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "news_title",
    "news_content",
    "live_market_prices",
    "soap_dynamics_stats"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "structured_knowledge_graph_facts",
    "daily_research_brief"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "You are a blockchain research analyst. Extract structured facts about the item below for a knowledge graph.",
    "PROJECT DATA GROUNDING (real, citable data from the Quai-RADAR dashboard):",
    "You are Fox writing the daily research brief for the Quai Network intelligence dashboard.",
    "LIVE MARKET: QUAI $0.010087544223399685 · QI $0.7875559257826807"
  ]
}
